subject: Request: Accelerator cohort credits for Luna Labs
messages:
From: Marta Gomes <marta@lunalabs.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example
Date: 2025-11-02T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Accelerator cohort credits request

Hi Markus,

We just signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow (company: Luna Labs) and are ramping an internal accelerator that starts Nov 10. Our engineers will run heavy evals and some demo showcases — conservative estimate ~150k tokens first 30 days. The self-serve credits aren't going to be enough for the cohort. Is there a path for a temporary top-up or promotional credits for accelerator partners?

Attached is a short cohort plan and the proposed schedule. We're also open to a short-term committed capacity if that's the recommended path.

Thanks — looking for a quick turnaround given the start date.

— Marta
Head of Platform, Luna Labs
marta@lunalabs.ai
Attachment: luna_cohort_plan.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)
From: markus_klein@redwood.example
To: Marta Gomes <marta@lunalabs.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: 2025-11-02T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort credits request

Marta — thanks for the note and attachment. I'm looping in Soojin (PLG credit triage) and Ben (partnerships) to evaluate.

Quick asks to speed review:
- Expected concurrency / peak qps during demos (rough numbers)
- Any data residency or compliance needs (EU-only, etc.)
- Are you evaluating a single model family (e.g., redwood-1/llama variants) or multiple?

If you can send those by EOD tomorrow I can try to get an initial decision before your Nov 10 start.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.example
From: soojin_lee@redwood.example
To: markus_klein@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: 2025-11-03T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort credits request — triage notes

Quick notes from triage:
- Luna Labs is a small startup accelerator alum; cohort is ~10 teams.
- From Marta: expected peak concurrency ~40 simultaneous sessions, mostly short-generation calls (<= 256 tokens) during demos; bulk evals with long sequences for 3 teams.
- No special residency requested (US-based infra okay).

Recommendation: grant a one-time promo credit of 200k tokens + escalate to Partnerships for a potential pilot discounted bundle if they convert. Policy note: standard self-serve promo caps at 100k, so this would need a manager approval (I filled internal_credit_request.xlsx).

Attachments: internal_credit_request.xlsx (requested amount + rationale), accelerator_agreement_draft.docx (from Partnerships for reference)

If we approve, I can send a templated activation + usage guidance and add rate-limit guardrails to prevent overages.

— Soojin
Senior Growth Ops, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.example
To: Marta Gomes <marta@lunalabs.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: 2025-11-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort credits request — approved provisional top-up

Marta — good news. We've provisioned a one-time promotional credit of 200,000 tokens to Luna Labs' account. You should see the credit applied within 30 minutes; it will be labeled "PLG Accelerator Promo — Nov 2025" in the billing console.

What we did:
- Applied 200k tokens promo to the account
- Put a temporary rate limit (60 qps aggregate) for the next 30 days to protect from runaway consumption
- Shared a short best-practices doc (link below) for batching and KV caching to stretch tokens

Next steps from your side:
- Confirm you received the credit and can run one smoke test by EOD Nov 6
- If you want a longer pilot/discounted commitment for the cohort, Ben on partnerships (cc'd) will follow up with a short pilot proposal.

Links:
- Activation: https://app.redwood.com/console/billing/credits
- Best practices doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/accelerator-agreement

Attachments: accelerator_agreement_draft.docx (for reference)

If anything breaks during your smoke test, reply here and we'll escalate immediately.

Thanks and good luck with the cohort — excited to see what the teams build.

— Markus
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.example
